description: This file contains shell functions for configuration management, package handling, user and group management, and system initialization tasks, primarily used within the OpenWrt firmware environment.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if DEBUG variable is set.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration using uci_load unless IPKG_INSTROOT is set.

methods.name: reset_cb
methods.description: Resets configuration callback functions to no-ops.

methods.name: package
methods.description: Stub function for package handling, returns success.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Creates a new configuration section with specified type and name.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets an option in the current configuration section.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adds an item to a list option in the current configuration section.

methods.name: config_unset
methods.description: Unsets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value, with optional default.

methods.name: config_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration value.

methods.name: config_set
methods.description: Sets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over configuration sections of a specific type.

methods.name: config_list_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over list items in a configuration section.

methods.name: default_prerm
methods.description: Performs package removal tasks, disables services.

methods.name: add_group_and_user
methods.description: Adds required groups and users based on package info.

methods.name: default_postinst
methods.description: Performs post-installation setup for packages, including enabling services.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes all shell scripts in a directory.

methods.name: find_mtd_index
methods.description: Finds the MTD index for a given partition.

methods.name: find_mtd_part
methods.description: Returns the device path for an MTD partition.

methods.name: group_add
methods.description: Adds a group with specified name and GID.

methods.name: group_exists
methods.description: Checks if a group exists.

methods.name: group_add_next
methods.description: Finds the next available GID and adds the group.

methods.name: group_add_user
methods.description: Adds a user to a group.

methods.name: user_add
methods.description: Adds a user with specified UID, GID, and other info.

methods.name: user_exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Returns the board name or 'generic' if unavailable.
